name: Ib
summary: Ib was a city carven of gray stone before mankind existed, recalled by the narrator as a point of comparison for the nameless city's unfathomable age.
description: Ib was carven of gray stone before mankind existed. The narrator's thoughts turned to it, alongside Sarnath the Doomed, while confronting the impossible antiquity of the nameless city.

sources.quote: of Ib, that was carven of gray stone before mankind existed

facts: It was carven of gray stone before mankind existed.
